title: Price reference
intro: Each unit price of the request against the prices of the same item on POs approved in the last {days} days, before VAT. The median is the price in the middle when sorted from lowest to highest; a line is flagged when its price is more than {threshold} away from it
vatNote: This request's prices include VAT, so no difference from the median is worked out: the median is a price before VAT
samples: {count, plural, =0 {No price on an approved PO yet} one {From # price on approved POs} other {From # prices on approved POs}}
excluded: {count, plural, one {# price including VAT left out} other {# prices including VAT left out}}
few: Few prices: at least {min} are needed for a sound comparison

quotes.title: Quotations of this request (before VAT)
quotes.notLowest: The chosen quotation is not the lowest. Reason: {reason}
quotes.notLowestNoReason: The chosen quotation is not the lowest
